lastCompletedStory.title: Add cam suggestions list CLI (parser + dispatch skeleton + help)

nextStoryContext: index.ts now has `parseSuggestionsArgs`/`dispatchSuggestions`/`SUGGESTIONS_HELP` (near `parsePatternsArgs`/`dispatchPatterns`/`PATTERNS_HELP`) and a `case 'suggestions':` in the command switch, registered in `HELP_REGISTRY` under the `suggestions` key. `parseSuggestionsArgs` mirrors `parsePatternsArgs` (bare `cam suggestions` and `--help`/`-h` both resolve to `{ help: true }`), but additionally rejects any trailing arg after `list` (`rest.length > 0` -> null) since this story's AC4 required 'unknown subcommand OR flag' to error -- `parsePatternsArgs`'s own `archive` branch does NOT enforce that (silently ignores extra args), so don't copy that laxity forward. `dispatchSuggestions(parsed, deps?)` takes `{ readFn?, writeStdout? }`; production `readFn` defaults to `readSuggestionsFromMain(process.cwd(), realSpawnFn)` (US-001, `src/commands/suggestions.ts`). Rendering is plain `writeStdout(...)` lines (fingerprint, title, `(sourceBranch[ round N])`), NOT the `src/logging/screen.ts` `emit*` helpers -- those write straight to `process.stdout` with no writer param, so they can't be driven through an injected fake without global monkey-patching; see patterns.md's newest bullet for the full rationale. Empty (or absent-from-main) pen prints 'No pending SUGGESTIONs in the pen.' and returns 0, never an error. The next stories in this PRD (per CAM-285's remaining backlog) are expected to add `cam suggestions promote <fingerprint>` and `cam suggestions dismiss <fingerprint>` subcommands: extend `ParsedSuggestionsArgs` as a 3-member discriminated union (`list` | `promote` | `dismiss`, each carrying a `fingerprint: string` field for the latter two) and extend `parseSuggestionsArgs`'s subCommand branch accordingly -- the `SUGGESTIONS_USAGE` string and `SUGGESTIONS_HELP`'s 'Subcommands' section will both need a matching update at that point, they currently only document `list`. `readSuggestionsFromMain`/`SuggestionEntry`/`SUGGESTIONS_JSONL_PATH` (US-001) are the only suggestions.ts exports currently consumed by index.ts; `appendSuggestionOnMain` is not yet wired into the CLI (only the sidecar hook, US-003, writes to the pen) -- promote/dismiss will need their OWN on-main writer (removing an entry or flipping a status field), which does not exist yet in suggestions.ts and is a new piece of plumbing, not a reuse of `appendSuggestionOnMain`.
